title: What will the announcers say during the Falcons vs Packers game?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed term is mentioned by a play-by-play announcer or a game analyst of the official Prime Video announce team during the English-language broadcast of the Atlanta Falcons vs Green Bay Packers game on Prime Video, scheduled for September 24, 2026 at 8:15 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

This market will resolve based on the events of the official game broadcast, beginning from the opening kickoff and ending with the conclusion of the final play of the game, including any overtime, if applicable. Pregame coverage, halftime studio coverage, and postgame commentary will not be considered.

For the purpose of this market, the "Prime Video announce team" refers only to the play-by-play announcer and the game analyst or analysts calling this game from the broadcast booth. Remarks made by sideline reporters, rules or officiating analysts, studio hosts, guest commentators, in-booth guests, players, coaches, or any other individuals will not count toward resolution, including when such remarks air during in-game interviews or in-game segments.

If this game is definitively cancelled, postponed, or otherwise does not air by September 25, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, "-No Qualifying Event-" will resolve to "Yes" and all other brackets will resolve to "No". If this game is interrupted, abbreviated, or only partially aired, this market will resolve according to what has occurred up to that point.

The resolution source for this market is the national Prime Video telecast of this game. Any alternate or simultaneous presentation of this game, including alternate broadcasts, alternate audio or commentary feeds, and separately produced local team telecasts, will not be considered for resolution purposes. Only remarks made live during the official broadcast will count toward this market's resolution. Transcripts will not count.

For full rules, see: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/market_products/Mentions/Event+Mentions+Contract+DeFi.pdf

title: What will the announcers say during the Giants vs Rams game?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed term is mentioned by a play-by-play announcer or a game analyst of the official ESPN announce team during the English-language broadcast of the New York Giants vs Los Angeles Rams game on ESPN, scheduled for September 21, 2026 at 8:15 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

This market will resolve based on the events of the official game broadcast, beginning from the opening kickoff and ending with the conclusion of the final play of the game, including any overtime, if applicable. Pregame coverage, halftime studio coverage, and postgame commentary will not be considered.

For the purpose of this market, the "ESPN announce team" refers only to the play-by-play announcer and the game analyst or analysts calling this game from the broadcast booth. Remarks made by sideline reporters, rules or officiating analysts, studio hosts, guest commentators, in-booth guests, players, coaches, or any other individuals will not count toward resolution, including when such remarks air during in-game interviews or in-game segments.

If this game is definitively cancelled, postponed, or otherwise does not air by September 22, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, "-No Qualifying Event-" will resolve to "Yes" and all other brackets will resolve to "No". If this game is interrupted, abbreviated, or only partially aired, this market will resolve according to what has occurred up to that point.

The resolution source for this market is the national ESPN telecast of this game. Any alternate or simultaneous presentation of this game, including alternate broadcasts, alternate audio or commentary feeds, and separately produced local team telecasts, will not be considered for resolution purposes. Only remarks made live during the official broadcast will count toward this market's resolution. Transcripts will not count.

For full rules, see: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/market_products/Mentions/Event+Mentions+Contract+DeFi.pdf

This market will resolve to the team defense and special teams (D/ST) unit that finishes Week 2 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season as the highest-scoring D/ST under the default scoring of ESPN Fantasy Sports.

Only games designated by the NFL as Week 2 of the 2026-27 regular season count. If two or more units are tied for the most fantasy points in Week 2, this market will resolve in favor of the tied unit whose team name comes first alphabetically.

If the highest-scoring D/ST in Week 2 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season is not a listed unit, this market will resolve to "Other".

If Week 2 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past October 7, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or a leader cannot be determined within this timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source will be official Week 2 statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).

The resolution source will be official Week 2 statistics as reported by ESPN Fantasy Sports (https://www.espn.com/fantasy/).

title: What will the announcers say during the Colts vs Chiefs game?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed term is mentioned by a play-by-play announcer or a game analyst of the official NBC announce team during the English-language broadcast of the Indianapolis Colts vs Kansas City Chiefs game on NBC, scheduled for September 20, 2026 at 8:20 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

This market will resolve based on the events of the official game broadcast, beginning from the opening kickoff and ending with the conclusion of the final play of the game, including any overtime, if applicable. Pregame coverage, halftime studio coverage, and postgame commentary will not be considered.

For the purpose of this market, the "NBC announce team" refers only to the play-by-play announcer and the game analyst or analysts calling this game from the broadcast booth. Remarks made by sideline reporters, rules or officiating analysts, studio hosts, guest commentators, in-booth guests, players, coaches, or any other individuals will not count toward resolution, including when such remarks air during in-game interviews or in-game segments.

If this game is definitively cancelled, postponed, or otherwise does not air by September 21, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, "-No Qualifying Event-" will resolve to "Yes" and all other brackets will resolve to "No". If this game is interrupted, abbreviated, or only partially aired, this market will resolve according to what has occurred up to that point.

The resolution source for this market is the national NBC telecast of this game. Any alternate or simultaneous presentation of this game, including alternate broadcasts, alternate audio or commentary feeds, and separately produced local team telecasts, will not be considered for resolution purposes. Only remarks made live during the official broadcast will count toward this market's resolution. Transcripts will not count.

For full rules, see: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/market_products/Mentions/Event+Mentions+Contract+DeFi.pdf

title: What will the announcers say during the Lions vs Bills game?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed term is mentioned by a play-by-play announcer or a game analyst of the official Prime Video announce team during the English-language broadcast of the Detroit Lions vs Buffalo Bills game on Prime Video, scheduled for September 17, 2026 at 8:15 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

This market will resolve based on the events of the official game broadcast, beginning from the opening kickoff and ending with the conclusion of the final play of the game, including any overtime, if applicable. Pregame coverage, halftime studio coverage, and postgame commentary will not be considered.

For the purpose of this market, the "Prime Video announce team" refers only to the play-by-play announcer and the game analyst or analysts calling this game from the broadcast booth. Remarks made by sideline reporters, rules or officiating analysts, studio hosts, guest commentators, in-booth guests, players, coaches, or any other individuals will not count toward resolution, including when such remarks air during in-game interviews or in-game segments.

If this game is definitively cancelled, postponed, or otherwise does not air by September 18, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, "-No Qualifying Event-" will resolve to "Yes" and all other brackets will resolve to "No". If this game is interrupted, abbreviated, or only partially aired, this market will resolve according to what has occurred up to that point.

The resolution source for this market is the national Prime Video telecast of this game. Any alternate or simultaneous presentation of this game, including alternate broadcasts, alternate audio or commentary feeds, and separately produced local team telecasts, will not be considered for resolution purposes. Only remarks made live during the official broadcast will count toward this market's resolution. Transcripts will not count.

For full rules, see: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/market_products/Mentions/Event+Mentions+Contract+DeFi.pdf

title: What will the announcers say during the Broncos vs Chiefs game?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed term is mentioned by a play-by-play announcer or a game analyst of the official ESPN announce team during the English-language broadcast of the Denver Broncos vs Kansas City Chiefs game on ESPN, scheduled for September 14, 2026 at 8:15 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

This market will resolve based on the events of the official game broadcast, beginning from the opening kickoff and ending with the conclusion of the final play of the game, including any overtime, if applicable. Pregame coverage, halftime studio coverage, and postgame commentary will not be considered.

For the purpose of this market, the "ESPN announce team" refers only to the play-by-play announcer and the game analyst or analysts calling this game from the broadcast booth. Remarks made by sideline reporters, rules or officiating analysts, studio hosts, guest commentators, in-booth guests, players, coaches, or any other individuals will not count toward resolution, including when such remarks air during in-game interviews or in-game segments.

If this game is definitively cancelled, postponed, or otherwise does not air by September 15, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, "-No Qualifying Event-" will resolve to "Yes" and all other brackets will resolve to "No". If this game is interrupted, abbreviated, or only partially aired, this market will resolve according to what has occurred up to that point.

The resolution source for this market is the national ESPN telecast of this game. Any alternate or simultaneous presentation of this game, including alternate broadcasts, alternate audio or commentary feeds, and separately produced local team telecasts, will not be considered for resolution purposes. Only remarks made live during the official broadcast will count toward this market's resolution. Transcripts will not count.

For full rules, see: https://polymarket-upload.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/market_products/Mentions/Event+Mentions+Contract+DeFi.pdf

title: Pro Football: 2026-27 Week 1 Highest-Scoring Team
description:
This market will resolve in favor of the team that scores the most points in Week 1 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season.

Only games designated by the NFL as Week 1 of the 2026-27 regular season count.

In the event of a tie, this market will resolve in favor of the tied team with more offensive touchdowns in Week 1 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season. If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the team with more total offensive yards (rushing yards plus passing yards) in Week 1 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season. If a tie still persists, this market will resolve to "Other".

If Week 1 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season is shortened or truncated for any reason, the outcome shall be determined using available NFL statistics for completed games.

If Week 1 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past September 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or it is unclear which team scored the most points within that timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the NFL; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

If a tie still persists, this market will resolve in favor of the player with a higher average of scrimmage yards per touch (scrimmage yards divided by the sum of rushing attempts and receptions) in Week 1 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season. If a tie still persists, this market will resolve to "Other".

If Week 1 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season is shortened or truncated for any reason, the outcome shall be determined using available NFL statistics for completed games.

If Week 1 of the 2026-27 NFL regular season is cancelled, postponed past September 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or it is unclear which player led the NFL in scrimmage yards within that timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from the NFL; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
